answer: Locks are recorded in dune, expire in island, and horizon lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 150 aliases as a result needs 117 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 94 dollars in locked collateral and another 12 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
